title: Moses and the Holy Land, Adam's Two Sons

paragraphs.text: Our Messenger came to the People of the Scripture. He came with light and a clear Book. Allah guides people to ways of peace. He brings them from darkness into light. Those who say Allah is Christ have disbelieved.

Moses told his people to enter the Holy Land. They feared a strong people there. Two men told them to trust Allah. But the people refused. "Go, you and your Lord, and fight," they said. So the land was forbidden to them for forty years. They wandered in the land.

Adam's two sons offered a sacrifice. Allah accepted it from only one. The other threatened to kill him. The first would not raise his hand to kill. But the other killed his brother. Allah sent a crow digging the ground. It showed him how to hide the body. He became full of regret.
